definition.name: Place Parking Bays From Table
definition.description: Place 261 M_Parking Space (4800 x 2400mm - 90 deg) parking bays on level Basement 2 at the positions in basement2_layout.json, rotated so the open end faces the aisle, with Comments set to each bay id (P-1 to P-261).
